title: Generative Data Augmentation Without External Data: An Empirical and Theoretical Study on Deep Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.21467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative data augmentation adds samples from generative models to a classifier's training set. Many influential studies use generators pre-trained on large external datasets, and so mix the value of synthetic data with knowledge transferred through pretraining. We study the case without external data, where each generator learns only from the classifier's own training set, and ask when and why adding generated samples to that training set raises or lowers the classifier's test accuracy. We train classifiers with four backbones on six datasets, two of them medical, adding samples from four generators. We bound the excess risk of a classifier trained with synthetic data, that is, how far its population risk can lie above the minimum risk within its hypothesis class. translated_title: 无需外部数据的生成式数据增强：对深度网络的实证与理论研究
translated_abstract: 生成式数据增强将来自生成模型的样本添加到分类器的训练集中。许多有影响力的研究使用在大型外部数据集上预训练的生成器，从而将合成数据的价值与通过预训练迁移的知识混杂在一起。我们研究无外部数据的情形，即每个生成器仅从分类器自身的训练集学习，并探讨何时以及为何向该训练集添加生成的样本会提高或降低分类器的测试准确率。我们在六个数据集（其中两个为医疗数据集）上使用四种骨干网络训练分类器，并添加来自四个生成器的样本。我们对使用合成数据训练的分类器的超额风险进行了界定，即其总体风险可能高出其假设类中最小风险的程度。该界定因真实分布与生成分布之间的总变差距离而对合成数据进行惩罚，同时因训练集规模的扩大而给予合成数据相应的收益。该...
tldr: 本研究首次系统研究了不依赖外部数据的生成式数据增强，通过理论证明其收益由生成分布与真实分布间的总变差距离带来的代价与训练集扩大带来的收益之间的权衡决定，并通过多骨干、多数据集（含医疗数据）的实验验证了生成样本何时能提升或降低分类器的测试准确率。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first empirical and theoretical study of generative data augmentation without external data, showing that its benefit is governed by a trade-off between the total variation distance between real and generated distributions and the gain from a larger training set, validated through extensive experiments across multiple backbones and datasets, including medical ones.
